summary.latency_scope: Sequential end-to-end in-process explanation calls, including network and rendering; no load/concurrency inference. Nearest-rank percentiles; no unreported warmup requests.

cost.basis: Per million tokens, standard synchronous text requests. Usage-based estimate, not an invoice. Unknown models/tiers or missing usage are never priced as zero. Reasoning tokens are already included in output tokens.

quality.scope: Frozen development-visible synthetic cases. Contract/text/citation checks use reviewed rule output, not an independent semantic grader. Final application scores include rule fallback; accepted-model scores exclude it. No human rating or unrestricted model reasoning claim.

scope: Tests provider plan validity. Rendered factual claims are generated by reviewed rules; this is not independent LLM semantic or usefulness validation.
